title: Aponte conspiracy
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Aponte conspiracy", at revision 1380426350, opens: "The Aponte conspiracy was a large-scale slave rebellion in Cuba that occurred in 1812. It is named after its alleged leader, José Antonio Aponte." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5784367, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "slave rebellion in Cuba". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
